ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the circuit is a 30 V power supply, connected through the top series resistor R_series = 2.2 kΩ to the output node; this node is connected downward to ground through a Zener diode labeled Vz = 12.5 V, and at the same time there is a load resistor R_load on the right side connected to ground. Reasoning calculation: According to the method given in the problem, assume the Zener diode is in the voltage-regulating state, so the output node voltage is fixed at 12.5 V. The series resistor current is I_series = (30 - 12.5) / 2.2 kΩ = 17.5 / 2200 A = 7.9545 mA. The load current is I_load = 12.5 / 5 kΩ = 12.5 / 5000 A = 2.5 mA. By node KCL, the Zener current I_zener = I_series - I_load = 7.9545 - 2.5 = 5.4545 mA, approximately 5.46 mA.

raw_record.question_text: Calculate the current through the zener diode for the given load resistance in the circuit shown in the figure. Given \( R_{\text{load}} = 5\,k\Omega \), the zener current \( I_{\text{zener}} \) is ______ mA.

method.method_draft: Assume the zener is regulating, so the output/load node is fixed at 12.5 V. Compute the current through the 2.2 kΩ series resistor as (30 - 12.5)/2.2 kΩ. Compute the load current as 12.5/5 kΩ. Apply KCL at the node: Izener = Iseries - Iload, then convert to mA to obtain about 5.46 mA.

method.method_draft: Convert the left source and series resistor into a Norton equivalent: IN = 30/2.2 kΩ. Since the zener clamps the output node to 12.5 V, the current through the Norton shunt resistor is 12.5/2.2 kΩ and the load current is 12.5/5 kΩ. The remaining Norton current must flow through the zener: Izener = 30/2.2 kΩ - 12.5/2.2 kΩ - 12.5/5 kΩ, giving about 5.46 mA.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个齐纳二极管稳压电路。左侧有一个标注为 Vsource = 30 V 的电压源，经过顶部串联电阻 Rseries = 2.2 kΩ 接到输出节点；输出节点向下接有齐纳二极管，标注 Vz = 12.5 V，并且右侧并联接有负载电阻 Rload 到地。

推理：按指定方法，把左侧 30 V 电源和 2.2 kΩ 串联电阻转换为 Norton 等效。Norton 电流为 IN = 30 V / 2.2 kΩ = 13.636 mA。齐纳二极管导通稳压时，输出节点被钳位在 12.5 V。因此 Norton 并联电阻中的电流为 12.5 V / 2.2 kΩ = 5.682 mA。给定负载电阻 Rload = 5 kΩ，负载电流为 12.5 V / 5 kΩ = 2.500 mA。剩余电流流过齐纳二极管：Izener = 13.636 - 5.682 - 2.500 = 5.454 mA，约为 5.46 mA。
